chunks: Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn al-Fadl ibn al-Mughirah narrated to us, saying: Abu Nasr Mansur ibn Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim al-Isfahani narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Abd Allah narrated to us, saying: al-Husayn ibn Bashshar narrated to us, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon them both)
He (AS) said: I asked him: Does Allah know the thing that has not yet come into existence, how it would be if it were to come into existence, or does He know only what will come into existence?
He (AS) said: Verily, Allah, the Exalted, is the Knower of things before they come into existence,
Allah, the Mighty and High, says: 'Surely, We wrote what you did.'
And He says to the people of Hell: 'And if they were sent back, they would certainly go back to that which they are forbidden, and most surely they are liars.'
Hence, Allah the Mighty and High, knew that if He sent them back, they would certainly go back to what they were forbidden.

And He said to the angels when they said: 'What! Wilt Thou place in it such as shall make mischief in it and shed blood, and we celebrate Thy praise and extol Thy holiness?' He said: 'Surely, I know what you do not know.'
Therefore, the Knowledge of Allah, the Mighty and High, is eternal, and embraces all things even before they are created.

Blessed be our Lord, the Exalted, the Elevated, and the Great, who created things and had knowledge of them prior to their creation as He willed. Thus, our Lord has always been All-Knowing, All-Hearing, and All-Seeing.
ai.seo_question: Does Allah know things that have not yet happened?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that Allah’s knowledge is eternal and precedes the actualization of events, refuting the view that He only knows what comes to pass. By citing the angels' surprise at human creation and the fate of Hell's inhabitants, the Imam demonstrates that divine knowledge encompasses both actual and potential realities, a cornerstone of Shia theological understanding of God's omniscience.
